submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I sampled the Ca-poor end, the middle (CaMn2O4 stoichiometry) and the Ca-rich end of the composition line. Photocurrent rose steeply toward the Mn-rich end: 1.73e-6 A at Ca 0.267, compared with 1e-7 A at Ca 0.333 and 4e-8 A at Ca 0.495. Index 16 sits at the Mn-rich edge of the library, which is where the trend points (index 28 has the same composition).

rejected.reason: Measured 1e-7 A, about 17x lower than index 16
Measured 4e-8 A, the lowest; the CaMnO3-like Ca-rich end performs poorly
